Kitchen staff flow: Staff login → view live order queue sorted by priority/time → select order → mark as preparing → update items as completed → mark full order ready → order moves to pickup area

Concurrent order handling: Multiple customers place orders simultaneously → verify all orders appear in KDS → verify no order loss or duplication → verify correct order association with items and prices
Real-time sync verification: Customer places order → kitchen staff sees notification within <1 second → kitchen updates status → customer sees status change within <1 second

API security: Implement rate limiting on order endpoints to prevent abuse; use HTTPS/TLS for all communications
Payment security: If payment is integrated, ensure PCI compliance and secure handling of payment tokens (never store raw card data)
